north_star: Estimate hidden political and organizational conditions in irregular warfare from incomplete observations, with calibrated uncertainty.

portable_clean_clone_pytest.scope: GitHub-portable suite excluding tests whose declared inputs are gitignored historical panels, sealed holdouts, or generated result bundles

notes: Native scheduler-oracle horizon clipping was aligned with reference exact-continuation semantics.
Research-readiness scoring no longer infers empirical readiness from synthetic data-status wording.

current_focused_pytest.scope: recovery + repeated-dynamic runner + state-estimation + empirical focused suite after paired-substream/nullspace/robust-likelihood changes

global_particle_weighting.finding: Whole-country likelihood multiplication causes severe particle collapse as observed spatial dimension grows.
global_particle_weighting.example: At 17 localities and 64 particles, effective support fell to roughly 1-3% in the direct-oracle/mixed-proxy diagnostics.

localization.finding: Radius-zero localized marginal weighting removes most of the global dimensionality damage while preserving coherent full-world trajectories.
localization.radius_pilot: Radii 1 and 2 worsened recovery relative to radius 0 on the matched smoke worlds; neighboring evidence is not currently licensed by the observation model.

snapshot_identifiability.interpretation: Dynamics and priors may add identifying restrictions, but full snapshot identification is not available from the current mixed proxy design alone.

channel_ablation_64_particles.interpretation: No single channel explains the weak one-world information gain; single-channel effects are small and the full design remains rank-deficient.

component_localization.finding: Locality-only weighting still allowed finite-ensemble correlations to make reports reweight latent variables that the observation channel did not measure. Component localization restricts each marginal to channels with a declared non-zero loading on that variable.
component_localization.interpretation: Component localization is now the development estimator; locality-only and global weighting are retained as explicit ablations.

paired_observation_substreams.finding: Synthetic observation generation now uses deterministic unit/channel/purpose substreams so degradation sweeps alter only the declared stochastic mechanism and common retained reports keep the same noise/delay realization.
paired_observation_substreams.consequence: Earlier repeated-dynamic/failure-envelope contrasts generated with the sequential observation RNG are retained as provenance but superseded for comparative claims.

fully_structurally_resolved_blocks: government/insurgent physical via security proxy + insurgent physical anchor
government/insurgent administrative via administrative proxy + government administrative anchor
mixed_proxy_nullspace.interpretation: This is a property of the declared one-snapshot linear measurement design. Dynamics/priors can add restrictions but cannot be credited as observation information without separate recovery evidence.

interpretation: This is the first repeated-known-truth pilot showing positive average information gain for localized recovery.
The mixed-proxy and direct-oracle profiles are not a ranking: their channel counts, loadings, reporting probabilities, and noise structures differ.
The normal paired-difference intervals emitted by the runner are descriptive pilot diagnostics, not preregistered confirmatory inference.
Confirmatory world counts, particle counts, severity levels, and promotion gates remain to be frozen before a confirmatory run.

component_localization_prior_width_pilot.interpretation: The broad-prior failure of locality-only weighting is largely a state-component dimensionality problem. Mixed proxies remain weak at broad priors, which is a measurement-identifiability result rather than a reason to add simulator mechanics.

interpretation: Component localization now has positive information gain across repeated live synthetic trajectories, not only one-snapshot assays.
Locality-only weighting is sharper at this narrow prior but sacrifices posterior support and interval calibration, and it fails under broader priors.
Four worlds are intentionally underpowered; paired normal intervals cross zero and no confirmatory threshold is licensed.
repeated_dynamic_pilot_prepaired_superse.superseded_reason: Observation generation used one sequential RNG stream, so changing degradation parameters could shift unrelated later stochastic draws. Purpose-separated paired substreams now define the comparison contract.

interpretation: Aggregate recovery is positive but strongly target-dependent.
The locality-only ablation is slightly sharper in this narrow-prior pilot but materially less calibrated and less supported.
Four worlds are intentionally underpowered; no confirmatory threshold is licensed.

direct_oracle_diagnostic.interpretation: Previously zero-gain mixed-proxy coordinates become positively recoverable when directly measured, supporting a measurement-design rather than estimator-incapacity interpretation. The oracle and mixed profiles are different measurement contracts, not a ranking.

false_report_robustness_pilot.interpretation: A modest contamination floor behaves as robustness insurance in this development batch: little clean-data cost, higher support, and positive average information gain under 10-20% fabricated reports where the strict Gaussian likelihood becomes worse than the prior.

legacy_observation_rng_note: Repeated-snapshot and prior-width pilot numbers above predate the purpose-separated observation-substream change. They remain useful hypothesis-generating development evidence but must be rerun under the paired generator before confirmatory use.
